method:
Inputs (all read, none flown here): m2_rev3_fly v2.1 tables (sim6 v2.10-dev): e19|G73|L400|ant<X>|h285 (P6) and
e19|G73|ant<X>|h285 (P6b) - the commit predictor horizon X = 1.3 / 1.7 / 2.1 / 2.5 s puts the commit about X before the plain
relight trigger, the flight software then delays T_fire until 1.9 s of flow (amendment G, pgg_Tmin); their references
e19|G73(|L400)|h285 (decided horizon 2.90 s) and liq|none(|L400)|h285; nrLO|none|rh220 / rh250 (unpurged relight with the
drogue release held to >= E2 + 0.22 / 0.25 s) against nrLO|none|h285 (release at E2) and liq|none|h285. Combustion v2.4a
unpurged_outcomes_v2p4a.json (outcome classes per line state: no light, A3 before release, released then A3, success) and the
v2.4 line-state table used by the flights (rg01_line_states_v2p4.json, P_abort per state).
Method: (A) per arm and base: P (Wilson 95 %), the realised commit lead (first plain-trigger time - commit), T_fire after the
plain trigger, flow, E0 height, touchdown speed, failure modes; paired exact McNemar against the references. (B) P against
the realised lead, pooled over the contingency arms and bases, in lead bins. (C) gate-delay tolerance (DERIVED from the
nominal predictor tables): the commit happens at max(predictor time, gate opening); a gate opening delayed by D moves the
commit only when D > slack (commit - gate opening in the nominal run); the delay that brings the lead below L is
D_crit(L) = slack + lead_nom - L, with lead_nom = the plain-trigger lead when the plain trigger fired before E0, else the
lower bound 2.90 s. (D) the release-hold alternative: GNC trajectory P (SIM) and Combustion's classes (DERIVED/SIM):
P_total = P_success(class) x P_GNC; hazard = P_released_then_A3 (Combustion: release at E2); with the hold >= E2 + 0.22 s
the class moves to A3 before release only under Combustion's DERIVED gap-arrival bound (0.193 s, flow held at the lift) plus
the 0.022 s A3 detection. (E) the L* table: lead bins x decided action (186 (1)) x Combustion class x GNC P (nominal start and
the L400 bracket). Not modelled in the flights: lights during the vapour gap and the A3 abort itself (the classes stay
Combustion's), canopy dynamics (quasi-steady massless drogue), a commit the ECU refuses, valve-time dispersion. SIM on
DERIVED / ASSUMED inputs; no hardware data; not a physical approval.
Output: <out>/p6_late_commit_v1p1.json.

release_hold.status: SUPERSEDED by lead line 194 (3) / REV-COMB-3 R3-01: the 0.22 s hold came from one state; this block keeps the v1.0 evaluation of the rh220 / rh250 arms as evidence; the current comparator is release_hold_v1p1

hold_vs_gap_bound_superseded.tag: DERIVED (Combustion bound, flow held at the lift); the flights do not model the gap or A3; the bound under the flown command profile during the hold is TO-VERIFY (Combustion)

P_total_DERIVED_superseded_line194.rule: P_total = P_success(class, Combustion) x P_GNC(rh220, SIM, min over the two bases)
P_total_DERIVED_superseded_line194.note: no gain at the worst states (P_success 0 under LO and HI); a gain exists only in non-worst states, and the population means are over bracket records, not a probability; the expected gain is therefore not stated

lstar_table.decided_action: PURGE (2.5 s flow), T_fire = commit + 2.90 s
lstar_table.combustion_class: purged Tp2.5 worst: P_success 1.0 (v2.4a); v2.4 P_abort 0

lstar_table.combustion_class: purged Tp2.2 robust edge: P_success 1.0 (v2.4a); e19 = Tp1.9 robust edge, v2.4 P_abort 0

lstar_table.decided_action: PURGE; flow 1.9-2.1 s; T_fire ~0.2-0.4 s after the plain trigger
lstar_table.combustion_class: e19 = Tp1.9 robust edge (v2.4 P_abort 0); 1.9-2.2 s class not tabulated in v2.4a: TO-VERIFY (Combustion)

lstar_table.decided_action: PURGE (lead >= L* = 1.3 s); FSW holds T_fire until 1.9 s of flow: 0.6-1.0 s after the plain trigger
PURGE at the L* edge; T_fire ~1.0 s after the plain trigger

no purge, no unpurged relight (186 (1), unchanged by 194 (3)): drogue descent, vehicle loss; comparator only (194 (3)): unpurged relight with the population hold (H >= 0.30 s on the 200 N ramp, >= 0.19 s on the 500 N ramp, none with lift flow; not admissible with Pc invalid): release_hold_v1p1
lstar_table.combustion_class: PURGE NOT RUN: worst LO / HI P_success 0 (v2.4a, REV-COMB-3 confirmed); population (records, not probability-weighted) LO 0.18 lift flow / 0.40-0.47 ramp, HI 0.00-0.04
lstar_table.comparator: release_hold_v1p1 (P_GNC per arm, residual released-then-A3 per record group, P_total where stated)

gate-delay tolerance: the gate may open up to 2.96 s late (minimum slack over 6 tables) without moving the commit; a later opening moves the commit one for one

release_hold_v1p1.why_not_admissible: lead 186 (2) holds the command at the start level while the drogue is attached with Pc invalid: that is lift flow, for which no hold within W covers the population (latest A3 trip after E2 0.727 s LO unlined)
release_hold_v1p1.P_success_note: population means over bracket records, NOT probability-weighted (Combustion tag); 'ramp' = the reviewer's best case over modes (the 200 N ramp), 'lift_flow' = worst; the 500 N profile has no per-record P_success in the reviewer's table (TO-VERIFY: Combustion v2.4b per-record CSV); the worst states have P_success 0 under LO and HI in every mode
